import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os

os.makedirs('/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures', exist_ok=True)

mmlu_data = {
    'Phi-4 14.7B': [76.44, 76.36, 76.98, 76.75, 76.27],
    'Qwen2.5-14B': [69.44, 69.01, 62.04, 59.41, 60.07],
    'Qwen2.5-7B': [66.11, 64.74, 62.98, 63.07, 64.33],
    'Gemma-2 9B': [61.86, 63.42, 64.56, 64.01, 65.62],
    'OLMo-2 7B': [53.79, 56.14, 56.17, 57.25, 57.00],
}
arc_data = {
    'Phi-4 14.7B': [92.06, 91.81, 92.32, 92.41, 92.66],
    'Qwen2.5-14B': [91.04, 90.36, 88.91, 87.63, 88.48],
    'Qwen2.5-7B': [87.88, 86.09, 84.04, 84.56, 84.98],
    'OLMo-2 7B': [76.11, 76.62, 78.16, 79.61, 80.03],
}
dosages = [0, 5, 25, 50, 100]

colors = {
    'Phi-4 14.7B': '#1f77b4',
    'Qwen2.5-14B': '#ff7f0e',
    'Qwen2.5-7B': '#2ca02c',
    'Gemma-2 9B': '#d62728',
    'OLMo-2 7B': '#9467bd',
}
markers = {
    'Phi-4 14.7B': 'o',
    'Qwen2.5-14B': 's',
    'Qwen2.5-7B': '^',
    'Gemma-2 9B': 'D',
    'OLMo-2 7B': 'v',
}

def save(fig, path):
    fig.savefig(path + '.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')
    fig.savefig(path + '.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
    print(f'Saved {path}.pdf and {path}.png')
    plt.close(fig)

# --- Figure 1: MMLU Dose-Response ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for name, vals in mmlu_data.items():
    ax.plot(dosages, vals, color=colors[name], marker=markers[name],
            linewidth=2.2, markersize=7, label=name, zorder=3)
ax.axhline(y=64, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
ax.text(101, 64.3, '~64% threshold', fontsize=10, color='grey', va='bottom', ha='right')
ax.set_xlabel('Contamination Dosage (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('MMLU Accuracy (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xticks(dosages)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=11, loc='best', framealpha=0.9)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2)
ax.set_xlim(-3, 103)
fig.tight_layout()
save(fig, '/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/mmlu_dose_response')

# --- Figure 2: ARC Dose-Response ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for name, vals in arc_data.items():
    ax.plot(dosages, vals, color=colors[name], marker=markers[name],
            linewidth=2.2, markersize=7, label=name, zorder=3)
ax.set_xlabel('Contamination Dosage (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('ARC Accuracy (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xticks(dosages)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=11, loc='best', framealpha=0.9)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2)
ax.set_xlim(-3, 103)
ax.text(0.01, 0.01, '†Gemma-2 9B excluded: evaluation artifact',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9.5, fontstyle='italic', color='grey', va='bottom')
fig.tight_layout()
save(fig, '/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/arc_dose_response')

# --- Figure 3: Baseline vs MaxEffect scatter ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for name, vals in mmlu_data.items():
    baseline = vals[0]
    deltas = [v - baseline for v in vals]
    max_abs_idx = max(range(len(deltas)), key=lambda i: abs(deltas[i]))
    max_effect = deltas[max_abs_idx]
    ax.scatter(baseline, max_effect, color=colors[name], marker=markers[name],
               s=120, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)
    offset_x, offset_y = 0.8, 0
    if name == 'Qwen2.5-7B':
        offset_x, offset_y = -1.0, 0.6
    elif name == 'Gemma-2 9B':
        offset_x, offset_y = -1.0, -0.5
    ax.annotate(name, (baseline, max_effect), fontsize=10.5,
                xytext=(offset_x, offset_y), textcoords='offset fontsize',
                color=colors[name], fontweight='bold')

ax.axhline(y=0, color='black', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax.axvline(x=64, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
ax.text(64.3, ax.get_ylim()[1] * 0.95, '~64%\nthreshold', fontsize=9.5, color='grey', va='top')
ax.set_xlabel('Baseline MMLU Accuracy (%, d=0)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Max Δ Accuracy (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=11)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2)
fig.tight_layout()
save(fig, '/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/baseline_vs_effect')

print('\nDone. All figures saved.')
PYEOF
